verdict.rationale: The xAI API exposes core model capabilities (text, image/video generation, speech-to-text, tool/connector definitions) documented in an OpenAPI spec, suggesting a broad programmatic surface, but there is no explicit claim or evidence that UI-only features like Grok Bot's persistent cloud computer, Salesforce/email/calendar connectors inside chat, team workspace management, or SSO are exposed via API. missing for 10: explicit parity statement, API access to Grok Bot/connector UI features, API equivalents for team/enterprise management.
